description: This file defines the interface for a SocketServer class that manages socket communication, including opening connections, running threads, sending and receiving messages, and handling responses. It also defines a Response struct used for message exchange.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A data structure representing a response message with a channel ID and JSON content.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: A class providing socket server functionalities such as opening connections, running in a thread, sending and receiving messages, and closing connections.

methods.name: Response(uint32_t channel, const string& json_str)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Response with a channel ID and JSON string.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to the specified address and port, with a callback for reading responses.

methods.name: RunThread
methods.description: Starts the server in a separate thread.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs the server in the current thread.

methods.name: SendInvoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke message with a channel ID, token, and JSON payload.

methods.name: SendAttach
methods.description: Sends an attach or detach command for a specific channel.

methods.name: SendExit
methods.description: Sends an exit command to terminate the server.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a response message into the provided Response object.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the socket.

methods.name: RunThreadFunc
methods.description: Static function used as the thread entry point for running the server.
